incident-bot: PagerDuty Alert fired: HIGH - capacity_pool_3 queue backlog > 95% (autoscaler_convergence=stalled)

pagerduty-bot: Incident created — PD#INC-91827. Notified: @maria chen, @aj patel (primary on-call)

maria chen: acked. looking now. any visible errors in autoscaler logs? :eyes:

aj patel: Ack. grabbing dashboard. I see sustained enqueue rate spike + node churn earlier. autoscaler metrics show scale decisions delayed ~2m.

kevin li: i've pulled logs from the scale controller — seeing repeated "scale_decision_timeout" and kubernetes API 429s around 03:17 UTC. attaching snippet: ```WARN scale-controller: request to k8s API throttled (Retry-After: 1s)```

samantha rao: sounds like control-plane throttling causing the autoscaler to miss signals. customer impact? which routes are affected?

maria chen: ingress metrics: model-inference-route-qa and model-inference-route-prod both report 95th latency spike and token queue length growing. Prod error rate up 1.8% (usually 0.1%). Looks like backlog in request queue.

aj patel: PD timeline note: page fired at 03:15 UTC when queue length crossed 90%.

oncall-rotation: @kevin li can you try a manual scale-up for capacity_pool_3 to relieve immediate backlog? We'll revert if it overloads infra.

kevin li: initiating manual scale: `kubectl scale ds/capacity-pool-3 --replicas=8` -> response: `Error from server: too many requests`

maria chen: control plane still throttling. fallback plan: enable emergency burst capacity in dedicated pool? That needs infra lead signoff.

aj patel: alternative quick mitigation — enable request shedding on non-critical routes to free capacity for prod. Samantha can you identify safe routes?

samantha rao: on it. marking `embeddings-batch-async` and `dev-preview` as low priority and enabling 429-throttling at the edge for them. applying rule now.

incident-bot: Config change applied by samantha rao: `edge/route-priority` updated (dev-preview, embeddings-batch-async -> deprioritized)

maria chen: queue backlog dropped ~18% in next 90s. latency for prod improving slightly. still seeing some API 429s from k8s control plane.

aj patel: open question — why autoscaler didn't compensate earlier? Kevin can you check if the scaler saw the enqueue metric before throttling?

kevin li: scaler received metric bursts but hit `scale_decision_timeout` due to k8s API throttles. The controller retried but backoff prevented timely scale. I'm going to increase the controller's parallelism to accelerate decisions: `helm upgrade scale-controller --set controller.parallelism=6`

maria chen: rolling that now. watch pods. If helm change fails, fallback to restarting controller pod once to clear transient backoff.

kevin li: helm upgrade started. K8s responded; controller replicas increasing. controller logs now: `info: parallelism increased -> processing backlog`.

aj patel: good. any customer-visible errors that require notification? I can draft a short status update once we confirm stabilization.

maria chen: prod latency and error rate trending back to normal over last 3 min. queue length down to 40% of peak. marking impact as "partial degraded performance" for ~12 minutes window.

samantha rao: quick note — we applied a temporary ingress 429 rule; track for rollback after 30m.

oncall-rotation: handing off to next shift @aj patel for monitoring until full recovery confirmed. I will update PD with mitigation notes.

aj patel: taking over. I'll keep watch for 30m. timeline for postmortem? propose 48h follow-up with root cause analysis and permanent fixes: increase controller resilience to k8s throttling, circuit-breaker for scale decisions, and autoscaler backoff tuning.

kevin li: adding action item: add k8s API rate-limiting awareness to scale-controller (queue metrics fallback + local estimation)

maria chen: customer impact list: 3 enterprise customers showed short-lived increased latency; no request loss observed. recommend reaching out to top 2 if SLA-sensitive.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-91827 acknowledged by maria chen at 03:18 UTC. Status: Mitigated (degraded service)

maria chen: closing PD incident when stable for 15m. leaving thread open for handoff notes and postmortem assignment.

aj patel: note for postmortem: include timeline of k8s API 429s (03:15-03:23), controller backoff decisions, manual mitigations (edge deprioritization, controller parallelism bump).

samantha rao: adding runbook update: if control-plane throttling detected, perform route deprioritization first, then increase controller parallelism, then scale manually if control-plane allows.

maria chen: thanks team. I'll create the incident ticket in the tracker with the timeline and assign to eng-runtime and eng-sre for RCA. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Logging thread summary to incident log.

aj patel: handing off final monitoring to kevin for 15m, then will close.

kevin li: watching. all recovery metrics look stable at 03:28 UTC.

maria chen: closing thread — follow-up tasks in ticket INC-91827.
